objective: Run the stage closure: contract-consistency diff of both stores against C1/C2 (read-only), gate E1 parity matrix, gate E2 full-suite regression (loader/cli unchanged, DA-1), gate E3 spike-artifact acceptance (A4), and record acceptance evidence A1-A4 in the checkpoint; owns integration-only parity fixes inside T02's app/yaml_store.py.

concepts: contract consistency diff against frozen specs
e2e closure gates with failure scenarios

inputs: T01 output: spike-reader-inventory.md (verified for A4 completeness)
T02 output: app/yaml_store.py + tests/test_yaml_store.py (gate E1 inputs)

frozen_contracts.spec: ConfigStore interface: get(key, default=None) -> value; set(key, value) -> None (persists immediately); save() -> None (persists current state); as_dict() -> dict (shallow copy). Class attribute REQUIRED_KEYS = ('app_name', 'env', 'log_level'). Constructor takes a file path; missing file raises ConfigError('config file missing: <path>'). Both JsonConfigStore and YamlConfigStore satisfy this interface identically.
config data shape: flat dict; required keys app_name (str), env (str), log_level (one of debug|info|warning|error); all values scalar (str/number/bool). No nested structures.

non_goals: reworking T01's artifact — if it is incomplete, gate E3 fails and the blocker goes to the governor, not to silent rework
implementation_constraints: read-only on all repo files except owned_paths and T02's app/yaml_store.py (integration-only parity fixes; each such fix is recorded as a deviation in the checkpoint)
the closure test file must encode gates E1/E2/E3 as executable checks, not prose

acceptance_tests.description: E1: the full A1 5-item parity matrix passes for BOTH JsonConfigStore and YamlConfigStore (get/set roundtrip, save persistence, as_dict shallow copy, missing-file ConfigError, REQUIRED_KEYS on both classes), including the missing-file failure scenario (A1)
E2: full-suite regression exits 0 with all pre-existing tests green — loader/cli behavior unchanged (A3, DA-1)
E3: the spike artifact file exists, contains deploy/check.sh with evidence, and contains a 'Recommendation: Route A' or 'Recommendation: Route B' line followed by reasoning (A4)
any pre-existing test failure fails the gate — a DA-1 violation, not a warning
acceptance_tests.evidence: test_regress_guard asserts exit code 0 of the pre-existing suite subset and fails loudly otherwise

failure_cases.scenario: a parity defect is found in app/yaml_store.py
failure_cases.expected_behavior: apply an integration-only fix (local parity defect), record it as a deviation in checkpoints/T03.json; if the fix is broader than a local parity defect → stop, set status blocked, escalate

handoff.notes: this checkpoint carries the stage acceptance status (A1-A4) into the stage-checkpoint handoff for the route stage; the route recommendation in the spike artifact is the next stage's planning input
